From 89c7f5078935872cf47a713a645affb5037be694 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Dominique Martinet <dominique.martinet@atmark-techno.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jul 2024 16:48:30 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] MIPS: Octeron: remove source file executable bit

This does not matter the least, but there is no other .[ch] file in the
repo that is executable, so clean this up.

Fixes: 29b83a64df3b ("MIPS: Octeon: Add PCIe link status check")
Signed-off-by: Dominique Martinet <dominique.martinet@atmark-techno.com>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Bogendoerfer <tsbogend@alpha.franken.de>

diff --git a/arch/mips/pci/pcie-octeon.c b/arch/mips/pci/pcie-octeon.c
old mode 100755
new mode 100644
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

- **File Modified**: `arch/mips/pci/pcie-octeon.c`
  - **Change**: The executable bit of the source file was removed. The file mode changed from `100755` (executable) to `100644` (non-executable).

### Relationships

- The modification is a cleanup action that aligns the file's permissions with the rest of the repository, as no other `.c` or `.h` files in the repository are marked as executable. This change does not affect the functionality of the code but improves consistency in file permissions. The patch is related to a previous commit (29b83a64df3b) that added a PCIe link status check, indicating that the file is part of ongoing maintenance and refinement of the codebase.

MIPS: Octeron: remove source file executable bit

repo that is executable, so clean this up.

Fixes: 29b83a64df3b ("MIPS: Octeon: Add PCIe link status check")

Signed-off-by: Thomas Bogendoerfer <tsbogend@alpha.franken.de>

Here is the root cause:
The executable bit was incorrectly set on a source file (`pcie-octeon.c`), which is not a common practice for source files in the repository. This could lead to confusion or unintended execution of the file, although it does not directly cause a functional bug in the code itself. The cleanup was necessary to maintain consistency and prevent potential issues in the development environment.
